name: evopilot
description: A local-first Codex copilot that learns proven work habits and promotes them into safe, reusable extensions.

interface.shortDescription: A Codex copilot that improves with use.
interface.longDescription: EvoPilot learns evidence-backed preferences and multi-step workflows, preserves corrections and conflicts, drafts successful workflows into reviewable Skills, and blocks risky actions until a person grants an exact one-time approval.
defaultPrompt: Initialize EvoPilot with my preferences: discuss before building, recommend a default, act autonomously on local recoverable work, and ask immediately before dangerous or external actions.
Use EvoPilot to help me develop this idea before building it.
Show what EvoPilot has learned and generate my weekly learning report.
